en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a riverside castle complex set in flat farmland. The ensemble includes several tall square towers with steep roofs and small spires, gabled buildings in a Northern Renaissance style, inner gardens and orchards, and surrounding trees. A broad, gently curving river flows behind the castle, with fields and scattered farmhouses stretching to the horizon. The print has worn and torn edges, consistent with an old photographic postcard. No printed caption or handwriting is visible.
